# Personal Hub repository instructions

Before analyzing or editing this repository, read [`../AI_GUIDE.md`](../AI_GUIDE.md) completely and follow it as the canonical cross-model maintenance guide.

Then read the relevant module documentation. In particular, every Quotes change requires both `src/modules/quotes/AI_GUIDE.md` and `src/modules/quotes/README.md`. Use the current source, tests, Firestore Rules and runtime configuration to confirm behavior; preserve unrelated worktree changes.
